title: PlayGarden open-resource shortlist
method: Read-only primary web sources and license text. No source code installed or executed. Repository license verified at branch URLs, not immutable commits; no full transitive dependency or asset audit claimed.

resources.name: Three.js
resources.fit: Best fit for Bridge Blocks; also lightweight 3D presentation for Light Lab and Robot Routes.
resources.mobile: Good with low-poly scenes, capped pixel ratio, limited shadows and pointer/touch controls; requires GPU fallback handling.
resources.maintenance: Large current upstream with WebGL/WebGPU renderers and migration documentation; pin a tested release rather than dev.
resources.assets: Core license does not establish provenance of every example model, texture or font. Use original procedural geometry or separately cleared assets.
resources.dependencies: Core package manifest lists devDependencies, not runtime dependencies; addons and external decoders need their own audit.
resources.adaptation: Mount/unmount lifecycle, GPU disposal, resize, context-loss handling and reduced-motion mode.

resources.name: Matter.js
resources.fit: Future balance, lever and bridge-load puzzles. Not a 3D physics engine.
resources.mobile: Good for small fixed-step scenes; cap body count and avoid expensive collision meshes.
resources.maintenance: Current repository and package manifest available, version 0.20.0 observed; do not infer release cadence from version alone.
resources.assets: Use programmatic shapes; demo imagery is not needed.
resources.dependencies: Observed manifest has development tooling and optional/example helpers including poly-decomp; audit any helper actually bundled.
resources.adaptation: Keep educational win conditions deterministic; synchronize physics state with renderer, add reset and pause.

resources.name: Phaser
resources.fit: Future larger 2D arcade/puzzle catalog with scenes, input and asset loading; unnecessary second engine for the first small games.
resources.mobile: Explicit desktop/mobile browser support with Canvas/WebGL.
resources.maintenance: README describes actively maintained Phaser 4; audit and pin version because v3/v4 rendering architecture differs.
resources.assets: README explicitly reserves Phaser logo and characters. Example art is not automatically MIT.
resources.dependencies: Vendored engines/plugins and third-party example assets need separate notice review.
resources.adaptation: Lazy-load per game; bridge shell pause/restart/progress and destroy the game on navigation.

resources.name: 2048 (Gabriele Cirulli)
resources.fit: Optional number-merge game or source for input/board-state patterns, with new educational explanations.
resources.mobile: Upstream has swipe support; replace legacy viewport that prevents zoom and add visible directional controls.
resources.maintenance: Small established legacy codebase; browser compatibility and accessibility require current testing.
resources.assets: Do not import branding, icons or bundled fonts without separate provenance review; use system font and original UI.
resources.dependencies: Listed HTML scripts include polyfills; inspect their headers before copying. Index inspected without executing.
resources.adaptation: Extract state into module, add undo and seeded tests; keep attribution and remove claims that a derivative is the official site.

resources.name: PuzzleScript
resources.fit: Reference for grid rules, undo, level syntax and a later creator mode.
resources.mobile: 2D can be economical; exported controls and touch behavior still need validation.
resources.maintenance: Current source/docs available; no exact last-commit date established.
resources.assets: Engine license is not blanket permission for community games, authored levels or gallery art. Create original games.
resources.dependencies: Build package includes image compression and minification tools; engine/editor third-party credits must be reviewed before bundling.
resources.adaptation: Prefer original rule/state implementation for initial games; full integration needs editor/export security and lifecycle work.

resources.name: Blockly Games
resources.fit: Strong Robot Routes reference for sequencing and progressive programming lessons.
resources.mobile: Block dragging needs small-screen testing; simple tap-to-add instruction cards are safer for initial release.
resources.maintenance: Official repository moved from google to blockly-games; current source available, exact release recency not established.
resources.assets: Do not assume all game media or third-party subtree uses the top-level license. Use original robot/art/levels.
resources.dependencies: Based on Blockly and includes third-party directory; full subtree inventory remains a release gate.
resources.adaptation: Extract pedagogical ideas rather than entire app; if copying files retain Apache license/notices and mark changed files.

resources.name: PathFinding.js
resources.fit: Robot Routes route validation, hints and solution checks; A*, BFS and corner-crossing behavior.
resources.mobile: Small grids are cheap; do not run unbounded searches on main thread.
resources.maintenance: Legacy package manifest uses version 0.4.18 and Gulp 3-era tools; treat as algorithm reference rather than adopt its build chain.
resources.assets: No game art needed; visualization dependencies are separate from algorithms.
resources.dependencies: Runtime dependency heap 0.2.5 appears in manifest; inspect that package license before shipping it.
resources.adaptation: For tiny puzzles implement/test original BFS, including heading and instruction state when required; a shortest cell path is not always a shortest program.

resources.name: Hextris
resources.fit: Optional study of rotational matching; requires explicit license compatibility, asset and source-distribution review before integration.
resources.mobile: Canvas/mobile design exists, but legacy viewport disables zoom.
resources.maintenance: README says project is not actively maintained.
resources.assets: Vendor libraries, Font Awesome, Exo font, icons and social/store branding require independent review.
resources.dependencies: Current index contains AdSense, Google Analytics and several vendor libraries. Never embed upstream as-is for children.
resources.adaptation: If code is copied, preserve GPL obligations and corresponding source, do not relabel derivative MIT. Separate deployment alone is not a guarantee against copyleft scope; review integration. Remove tracking/ads and use fresh assets.

resources.name: ZzFX
resources.fit: Small original feedback sounds for all three games without downloadable audio samples.
resources.mobile: Start/resume AudioContext only after user gesture; global mute and conservative volume.
resources.maintenance: Current README provides module and micro versions; no exact last-commit date established.
resources.assets: Generate original presets; music, songs or third-party presets are separate content and need their own review.
resources.dependencies: README states standalone with no external libraries.
resources.adaptation: Use short gentle tones, precache and stop on pause; never make audio the only success/error signal.
resources.priority: Use now or keep native Web Audio

resources.name: Kenney Building Kit
resources.fit: Optional environment pieces for Bridge Blocks, not required for procedural MVP.
resources.mobile: Inspect polygon counts/materials after download; batch/instance repeated pieces.
resources.maintenance: Pack page lists 80 files, version 1.0 released 2024; static asset maintenance is less relevant than formats/provenance.
resources.assets: Official pack explicitly CC0. Check downloaded included license and record actual imported filenames; CC0 does not grant trademark rights.
resources.dependencies: No code dependency; chosen loader/decoder has separate license.
resources.adaptation: Normalize scale/orientation, simplify materials and keep gameplay silhouettes clear.

resources.name: Kenney Interface Sounds
resources.fit: Alternative gentle UI/feedback audio for the hub.
resources.mobile: Load only chosen small clips; user-gesture playback and mute control.
resources.maintenance: Official page lists 100 files and version 1.0 released 2020.
resources.assets: Explicit CC0 pack; archive included license and source URL with imported filenames.
resources.dependencies: No code dependency; media decoding uses browser APIs.
resources.adaptation: Audition for harshness, trim/normalize levels and pair all sounds with visible feedback.

resources.name: open-gomoku
resources.status: Actual Rust-to-TypeScript board/evaluation/alpha-beta adaptation. Original UI and 24 exercises. Runtime and browser release gates documented in docs/gomoku-campaign.md.
resources.dependencies: No added runtime dependencies or upstream WASM. Same-origin cancellable module Worker.
resources.privacy: No upstream analytics, remote fonts, accounts, chat, leaderboard or position upload.
resources.priority: Implemented, release tied to final commit CI
